title: Abu Dhabi Jiu-Jitsu World Championship
subtitle: 8-Mat Simultaneous Live Feeds & Instant Referee Video Review
venue: ARENA Space42, Zayed Sports City, Abu Dhabi
broadcaster: Abu Dhabi Sports & International Combat Streams
role: Senior Broadcast Engineer & Multi-Feed Matrix Lead
summary: Engineered an 8-mat simultaneous broadcast infrastructure delivering 8 discrete live stadium video feeds, centralized referee review video replay, and main arena show court broadcast coverage.

specs.cameras: Sony HDC-3500 + Jib Crane + Wireless Steadicams
specs.audioIntercom: RTS ADAM Intercom + Dante AoIP Network

technicalApproach: Engineered a centralized 128x128 Nevion matrix routing all 8 competition mats to dedicated referee touchscreens and online feeds.
Configured 3 synchronized EVS XT3 servers to log and instantly cue contentious point scoring and submission attempts.
Managed RF Steadicam and 40ft Jimmy Jib cameras for the grand championship final show court.

signalFlow.description: 24 camera lines across 8 mats routed to central OB patch panel
Instant touch-controlled replay distribution to mat-side referees
Sony MVS-7000X directing prime-time finals broadcast with slow-motion replays
WTvision live tournament bracket and scoring integration
10 discrete streams encoded for global streaming portals and Abu Dhabi Sports TV

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Mat 4 and Mat 7 had simultaneous contested gold-medal submissions requiring immediate video replay.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Dual-operator EVS workflow routing isolated angles to separate referee review monitors simultaneously.
challengesAndSolutions.impact: Both decisions resolved in under 15 seconds; broadcast pace was maintained without delay.

outcomes: Successfully streamed 8 simultaneous courts for 7 consecutive days with zero signal interruptions.
Earned official commendation from UAE Jiu-Jitsu Federation.
improvementReflection: Deploying automated AI clip-tagging for athlete names will accelerate social media highlight turnaround.
